raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With an FP8 KV cache on gfx950, Kimi-K3 `target_verify` is slow on any single kernel: `mla_gluon` wins at short contexts and the HipKittens kernel wins from a few thousand tokens up (up to 7x at bs=12, 128k). This PR picks the kernel on the host and captures one verify graph per kernel, following the review on ROCm/aiter#6961.

## Modifications

- `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND` defaults to `auto`. `asm` and `gluon` still force those paths and bypass K3 selection.
- In `auto` on gfx95 with FP8 KV, 8 draft tokens and no DCP, the AITER backend picks the kernel with AITER's `select_mla_verify_kernel(bs, max(seq_lens_cpu) + num_draft_tokens)` and calls `mla_verify_hk` or `mla_gluon`. When the host `seq_lens_cpu` is missing it picks `mla_verify_hk`, which serves any length, instead of reading the device lengths.
- `K3MlaVerifyGraphVariants` (`graph_variants.py`) captures a `gluon` and an `hk` verify graph per batch size through the existing attention-variant graph machinery, and replays the one the host picked.
- The K3 path no longer builds `get_mla_metadata_v1`, which neither kernel reads.
- The HipKittens kernel now lives in AITER, so its SGLang JIT source, asm generator, wrappers and kernel test are removed.

## Accuracy Tests

Kimi-K3, TP8 MI355X, FP8 KV, DFlash, `max-running-requests=12`, vs the same deployment on the previous on-device switch (McNemar):
- GPQA-D: 87.9% vs 87.4% (p=1.0); B300 86.9%
- AIME25: 93.3% vs 90.0% (29/30 graded on the baseline); B300 96.7%

`test/registered/unit/layers/test_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants.py` (selector input, both variants, decode/forced/unsupported paths): 3 passed on MI355X.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

One verify layer under graph replay, 1x MI355X, 25 shapes (bs 1-12, ctx 1k-128k): host selection is 1.0-5.8 us/layer faster than the on-device switch on 22 shapes and within run-to-run noise at bs 8/12 with 128k (3 repeated runs). Capturing both variants takes 0.46 GB vs 0.44 GB for the single graph. Full table in the AITER PR.

## Dependencies

ROCm/aiter#6961 (`aiter.mla_verify`). Without it, `auto` keeps the previous `asm` default.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+def k3_mla_verify_max_kv_len(
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch, num_draft_tokens: int
+) -> Optional[int]:

+"""K3 MLA target verify captures one graph per AITER verify kernel and picks it on the host."""
+
+import sys
+import unittest
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.graph_variants import (
+    K3MlaVerifyGraphVariants,
+    create_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants,
+    k3_mla_verify_max_kv_len,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _fake_aiter_mla_verify(calls):
+    mod = ModuleType("aiter.mla_verify")
+    mod.MLA_VERIFY_HK = "hk"
+
+    def select_mla_verify_kernel(batch_size, max_kv_len):
+        calls.append((batch_size, max_kv_len))
+        return "hk" if batch_size * max_kv_len >= 30000 else "gluon"
+
+    mod.select_mla_verify_kernel = select_mla_verify_kernel
+    return mod
+
+
+class TestK3MlaVerifyGraphVariants(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_max_kv_len_adds_draft_tokens(self):
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([5, 900, 17]))
+        self.assertEqual(k3_mla_verify_max_kv_len(batch, 8), 908)
+
+    def test_missing_host_lengths_pick_hk_without_a_device_read(self):
+        calls = []
+        variants = K3MlaVerifyGraphVariants(num_draft_tokens=8)
+        # A device max would sync; seq_lens is never read.
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(batch_size=2, seq_lens_cpu=None, seq_lens=None)
+        with patch.dict(
+            sys.modules, {"aiter.mla_verify": _fake_aiter_mla_verify(calls)}
+        ):
+            self.assertIsNone(k3_mla_verify_max_kv_len(batch, 8))
+            self.assertEqual(variants.select(batch), "hk")
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [])
+
+    def test_select_uses_batch_size_and_max_kv_len(self):
+        calls = []
+        variants = K3MlaVerifyGraphVariants(num_draft_tokens=8)
+        self.assertEqual(variants.capture_labels, ("gluon", "hk"))
+        with patch.dict(
+            sys.modules, {"aiter.mla_verify": _fake_aiter_mla_verify(calls)}
+        ):
+            short = SimpleNamespace(
+                batch_size=2, seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([100, 2000])
+            )
+            long = SimpleNamespace(
+                batch_size=2, seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([100, 20000])
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(variants.select(short), "gluon")
+            self.assertEqual(variants.select(long), "hk")
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [(2, 2008), (2, 20008)])
+
+    def test_factory_only_for_k3_target_verify(self):
+        k3 = SimpleNamespace(use_k3_mla_verify=True, num_draft_tokens=8)
+        hybrid = SimpleNamespace(full_attn_backend=k3)
+        for backend in (k3, hybrid):
+            variants = create_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants(
+                backend, ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(variants, K3MlaVerifyGraphVariants(8))
+        self.assertIsNone(create_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants(k3, ForwardMode.DECODE))
+        forced = SimpleNamespace(use_k3_mla_verify=False, num_draft_tokens=8)
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            create_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants(forced, ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY)
+        )
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            create_k3_mla_verify_graph_variants(
+                SimpleNamespace(), ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY
+            )
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
